quest.title: Darknight Hero's Alibi
quest.description: Knight Huffman has informed you that the Abyss Order is plotting against the Darknight Hero. As a precaution, the Knights have decided to monitor the Darknight Hero's actions. You shared this information with Diluc and discussed countermeasures. Having made your preparations, you now lie in wait for both the Knights and the Abyss Order to act.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x300, Primogem x60, Mora x13850, Teachings of Resistance x5, Adventurer's Experience x6, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Master Diluc! Paimon has something important to tell you—

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Yes... about Kaeya...

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: I should have known he would see this as the perfect opportunity to get back at me.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sounds like there's a bit of bad blood between you guys then?

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: I shan't get into that now. More importantly, the Knights of Favonius are responding more or less as I had anticipated.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: All we need to do now is think of a counter plan.

choices.text: Steer clear of the tavern, for starters.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: That won't work. It will only arouse the Knights' suspicion if I don't show up as they're expecting.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: That's what Kaeya is counting on.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... so what are we gonna do?

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Patience. Let me think for a moment...

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: If they intend to monitor me, then so be it.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: We can use this to create the perfect alibi.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What's an alabla— an alibi?

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: If you want to find out, maybe you can do me a small favor first.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh come on! Why do you love cliff hangers so much?

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: In Mondstadt, Mist Flowers are most commonly found in a region just <color=#00E1FFFF>northwest of the winery</color>.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: If you could gather some for me, I'd be most grateful. I will make other preparations here in the meantime.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whew... Such a powerful effect from such a small amount of extract. At least we didn't go picking wild flowers for nothing.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright! So can you tell us what your plan is now, Master Diluc?

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Yes. The plan is...

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: ...and so I expect it to all go down without a hitch.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... Are you sure it will work?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You're the only person in the plan...

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: I have persevered alone from the start.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Now, I alone must face what lies ahead.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well... if you already made up your mind...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #But until that moment comes, {NICKNAME} and Paimon can still help you out where we can. Isn't that right, {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: I am indeed indebted to you. I shall see you at the <color=#00E1FFFF>tavern</color>, as per the plan.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! Don't be so cheeky!

talks.objective: Collect Mist Flower Corolla from beside the water
Give 4 Mist Flower Corolla to Diluc

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Ah, you're back.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Allow me to introduce the winery's master brewer—

dialogues.speaker: Connor
dialogues.text: So many Mist Flowers... Great! I can't wait to see how this turns out!

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: So, are you certain the equipment can withstand this level of purity?

dialogues.speaker: Connor
dialogues.text: Oh my... my goodness, the winery owner himself is addressing me directly!

dialogues.speaker: Connor
dialogues.text: Don't worry, sir! It is always my honor to serve you, even if it means risking my life!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? What's so life-threatening about this?

dialogues.speaker: Connor
dialogues.text: Please excuse me — I must get to work!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's he gonna do with a bunch of Mist Flowers?

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Long story short...

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: A few days ago, the winery was experimenting with some new flavors. They wanted to see if Mist Flower can truly add a crisp and refreshing taste.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Sure enough, they discovered that the flower's extract is truly potent.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So the new batch is selling like hot cakes?

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: No, not potent in terms of attracting customers, but slimes.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Slimes need to extract elemental energy to survive... For them, this substance is simply irresistible.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: So I thought to myself, "I wonder how much trouble I could cause now that I know this..."

dialogues.speaker: Refining
dialogues.text: *bang crash wallop*...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yikes! What was that noise?

dialogues.speaker: Connor
dialogues.text: Ah... C—Cold... so c—cold... Master Diluc, purification complete, sir! B—But the equipment is...

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Marvelous work. Don't fret about the equipment, I shall have my butler order more immediately.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "Marvelous! Jolly-ho! Spiffing! Somebody fetch the butler!" Paimon never knew you had to be so well-spoken to get a job in the alcohol industry.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: This is what I was talking about.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Mist Flower extract... or for our purposes, "Elemental Bait."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, it really has a strong elemental... whiff! Can we test it out?

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Sprinkle a little on the ground over there — careful, just a small amount.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Greetings, Mr. Huffman of the Knights of Favonius. To what do I owe the pleasure at this hour?

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: ...Oh, erm, nothing... I'm merely procrastinating. I thought I might indulge myself with a beverage or two.

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: Ah, Traveler! Fancy meeting you here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, we were in the mood for an evening stroll.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: What would you like to drink?

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: I'll have a Dandelion Wine, I suppose.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, Paimon wants apple juice!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #...Aw, but Paimon forgot to bring her coin pouch! {NICKNAME}, do you have any Mora on you?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And then? That's it?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How long does it take before...
*squelch squelch*

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Holy moley, it really does attract slimes! ...And even more than we expected...

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: It appears the potency is greater than anticipated...

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: We'd better get rid of them before they wreak havoc on the manor.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Classic Master Diluc — not a baddie left standing.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Nothing more than a few hilichurls.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: No time to chat. I don't know how long those slimes will keep Huffman occupied. Best get back to the <color=#00E1FFFF>tavern</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: In Mondstadt, Mist Flowers are most commonly found in a region just <color=#00E1FFFF>northwest of the winery</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Once you've gathered enough <color=#00E1FFFF>Mist Flowers</color> I will discuss the plan further with you.

talks.objective: Pose as a customer and speak to Diluc
Place the elemental bait near the side gate

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Hmm? You'd better get on with it, I can't wait all evening.

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: It's only a couple of fruit juices, really, let me get them for you.

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: ...Captain Kaeya is no doubt a formidable knight, but he also brings us more than his share of hassle...

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: No, this isn't right. I should not be talking about my superior in such a manner. If he were to overhear me...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We're back! Is my apple juice ready?

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: One moment.

dialogues.speaker: City Gate Guard
dialogues.text: Mr. Huffman, Mr. Huffman! A situation at the side gate! Everyone to the side gate!

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: What is it? What happened?

dialogues.speaker: City Gate Guard
dialogues.text: It's... Slimes, Mr. Huffman.

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: Slimes? You see them all the time, what's the big panic?

dialogues.speaker: City Gate Guard
dialogues.text: We do, but... Sir, there are more slimes out there now than all the slimes I've seen in my life added together!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ahh... Whoa...

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: Surely this couldn't be the Abyss Order's secret weapon...

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: But... I have another matter to attend to here—

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Oh? The matter of your Dandelion Wine?

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: N—No, I... That's not what I meant...

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Hmph. So this is how the Knights of Favonius conduct themselves in a crisis.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: The Abyss Order is encroaching on the city gates, and your response is to sit here... drinking wine?

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: It's like I've always said. The Knights are not to be trusted.

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: *sigh* Master Diluc is right, my conduct here has been below par.

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: I shall set off at once. But first...

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, may I have a quiet word?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: Shh, keep your voice down. I presume you know what this is about. Please watch Diluc for me — do not let him leave under any circumstances!

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: I must head to the side gate, but I'll be back shortly. I'm counting on you!

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Good. That's him out of the way.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Everything's going according to plan!

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: I must get going too. I won't have a second to spare if I'm to be back in time.

talks.objective: Face the Abyss Order head-on at Mondstadt's front gate
Return to the tavern before Huffman

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: It seems Huffman hasn't yet returned.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: We made it in time.

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: *panting* ...The situation is sorted now. I never expected that the Abyss Order's army would turn out to be nothing more than a few slimes.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: That is a surprise.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Perhaps the Knights' true calling is to be slime exterminators. Who knows, domestic pest control may turn out to be a more valuable use of your resources.

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: Master Diluc, please, have you no respect at all...

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, how come you're sweating so much? You didn't leave, did you?

choices.text: No, it's just really warm in here.

response.speaker: Huffman
response.text: Is it...? But if that's the case, why are you also out of breath?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh-oh, Huffman is getting suspicious!

response.speaker: Huffman
response.text: Hmm...

response.speaker: Huffman
response.text: Excuse me, sir. Might I be so bold as to inquire...

response.speaker: Huffman
response.text: ...Did you see Master Diluc— I mean, today's bartender... Did you see him leave just now?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yikes! He's asking other customers... We're done for!

response.speaker: Patrons
response.text: Master Diluc? Why no, he's been behind the bar this entire time.

response.speaker: Huffman
response.text: I see...

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Mr. Huffman, your Dandelion Wine.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: You ought to get back after this. Send my regards to the rest of the Knights.

response.speaker: Huffman
response.text: Oh... Never mind, I must be going, I should report back. Here, take this as a token of my esteem.

response.speaker: Huffman
response.text: Hmm... How odd...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Phew! That was too close! Paimon was sure we were toast...

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: I foresaw this eventuality...

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: ...So all the guests here tonight, save you two, are my own people from the Dawn Winery.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: They're all in on it?

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Not all of them... Or should I say, not all of us.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Kaeya!? Where did you come from?

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: I just picked a good spot to quietly sit and watch the show.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whaaa... You've been here this whole time!?

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Correct. "The Darknight Hero's Alibi..." I think it's my favorite chapter so far. More intriguing than a fine wine.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Hmph...

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: So? You plan to report everything to the Knights of Favonius?

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Haha... Come now Diluc, you know me better than that. I have no interest in exposing secrets.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: I was just curious to see how far Mondstadt's Darknight Hero would really go.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: And you did not disappoint.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: I have nothing to prove to you.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Oh, naturally.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: I must say though, one thing I didn't see coming is that the mighty Darknight Hero would actually need help from other people...

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Sorry, we're closing. Please see yourselves out.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Alright, alright... I have no further need of wine to entertain myself tonight, in any case.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Just one last thing before I go.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: It had better be the very last thing.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: I feel strangely comforted by the fact you now have an assistant, Diluc.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: I hope you all have a wonderful night.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What was all that about?

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Don't mind him.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Thank you for all your help with this matter. This is a token of my gratitude.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Woooow! Thanks Master Diluc!

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: I'm in the habit of working alone, but I did enjoy having your assistance this time.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: In the future, if there's anything you ever need, you can come to me for help.

response.speaker: Huffman
response.text: Is that so? But why now of all times, for the love of Barbatos...

dialogues.speaker: Connor
dialogues.text: The method for obtaining Mist Flower extract is kind of my own invention... So please keep it a secret until I've managed to publish it.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Let's discuss the plan some more after we've dealt with these slimes.
